svg.aria-label: Experience — From hardware labs to prod. Software Developer Intern at Soterguard · Stoam SaaS & On-Premise Systems (May 2026 → Present · Barcelona · Hybrid): Stoam Connect connects B2B & B2C platforms, CRMs and ERPs (Sage, A3ERP, Odoo) via REST APIs, webhooks & n8n. Developing, maintaining & deploying web applications and On-Premise client solutions under Agile/Kanban workflows. Designing server logic & APIs in Node.js, strict TypeScript & Python with relational PostgreSQL (PrismaORM). Configuring virtualized & production environments in Docker & WSL while resolving client incidents. IT Hardware & Systems Intern at VimTech · Servicio Técnico Informático (Sep 2024 → Mar 2025 · El Masnou, Barcelona): Hardware diagnostics, repair & maintenance with specialization in Apple devices (Mac, iPhone, iPad). OS installation, system auditing & personalized technical advisory across macOS, Windows & Linux. IT Support & Web Developer (Volunteer) at AJMA · Associació Juvenil de Mitjans Audiovisuals (Mar 2023 → Aug 2025 · El Masnou, Barcelona): Designed, built & continuously maintained the association's official website (ajma.es) and Nginx web infrastructure. IT equipment support and live audiovisual technical operation (camera & sound) at cultural events.
